segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the gel cleanser as effective at removing excess oil and makeup, with one calling it tight and clean afterward, though one oily/acne-prone reviewer reports it clogged her pores and broke her out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it cleans without stripping or tightening their skin, while others report it left their face tight, dry, or stripped of moisture.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally say it balances oily and dry areas well and clears blemishes, though one combination/acne-prone reviewer felt it did nothing for her skin.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin (including eczema and psoriasis) report the cleanser is gentle, non-irritating and does not cause breakouts, but a few describe it causing tightness, redness, or reactions, especially citing the spearmint scent.
segments.mature: One reviewer speculates the formula may not be as rich as products aimed at mature skin, but reports no direct experience of it underperforming for that purpose.

concerns.aging: One reviewer noticed a reduction in fine lines on her forehead after weeks of combined use with other products, but this is not attributed to the cleanser alone by most others; no other aging-specific reports.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out or strip their skin and even feels moisturizing; others describe tightness, dryness, or moisture loss after use, particularly with dry or sensitive skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the cleanser reduced redness and did not irritate their skin in most cases, but a few sensitive-skin reviewers specifically flag redness and irritation from the spearmint ingredient.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and gentle enough not to compromise their skin barrier, with only one review linking it to tightness and stripped-feeling skin.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visibly fewer spots, bumps, and clearer skin within one to two weeks of use; no reviewer reports new spot formation directly from this product.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report noticeable acne and blemish improvement, including clearer skin and fewer breakouts over weeks of use; however, one reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin blames a specific ingredient (red algae extract) for pore clogging, and one combination/acne-prone reviewer saw no effect.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it controls oil well without over-drying, describing their forehead as less oily after use; no reviews report increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: I've been looking for a gel cleanser for a while and found this one. I have oily and acne-prone skin which ended up NOT being a good combo with this cleanser. I took a further look into the ingredients and it contains rhodophyceae extract (red algae extract). I would stay away from this if you are acne-prone.

While this product is so CUTE it's not good for dry sensitive skin. It made my skin tighten and it strip the moisture out of my pores. Honestly you have rinse again and it feels the same. I use it has decoration In my vanity organizer , I recommend the bymoa cream cleanser if you don't mind about the smell. or just use miscellar water to wash your face, or try soft launch i heard it's really good.

As others have said, this face wash can be a bit drying so its def not for the dry skin crowd. I dont mind too much as i have oily skin. It removes makeup and cleans well. However there is a reason pump bottles have long necks. The pump is just too short. You cannot put your hand underneath. You need to pick up the bottle and pump sideways into your palm and even then product still trails down the bottle. I get aesthetics are a thing but just make the bottle normal, please.

Nice mild facial soap. I have a combination of an oily t zone and very dry cheeks so most cleansers seem to address one problem at the expense of the other. I use this to wash my face in the shower in the morning and it's not making my forehead really oily The pump only gives out a small amount so I have to pump it three times. Also there's no fragrance yay.

I bought this product per recommendation from a friend. And let's just say this was the best decision I have made. I always struggled with finding skincare that works for me because my skin is so sensitive and difficult. I have dry skin (sometimes combination) and suffer from psoriasis and this brand just makes my skin look beautiful. I loved it so much I own everything from the entire brand now. It works together in perfect harmony creating hydrated even and beautiful skin. I would confidently buy this again and again.

I love the way this gel cleanser feels on my skin after I wash , it feels tight and clean! Also the price isn't that bad I believe I paid around $10-11 for this cleanser and it's one of the best affordable ones out there. Also my skin is oily so this feels amazing for my skin! Hopefully this review helps !

extraits.titre: 30 years old and I love it.
extraits.texte: Im attracted to colorful things. While neutrals are in, the kid in me will forever be attracted to colorful things. I got travel minis to try this and the blue gel cleanser is my absolute favorite - i bought it full size. While im 30, i still struggle with acne sometimes and im super oily in summer and dry in winter. This thoroughly cleans my face, while still feeling comfortable. My face looks brighter and ive noticed less acne or spots using this. I have sensitive skin as well - no issues for me. I have ditched everything i use for this line. While im sure its not as rich as products designated for maturing skin, i contest that their products at high dollar doesnt even work that good. This is affordable AND works. Thank you for this line. Please do not ever make the mistake of changing formulas. Your products have good reviews for a reason.
